HOW I DID THE DIFF. The version I judged in round 1 (sha256 b9041f8b...) was not saved, by me or by anyone: I searched the scratchpad by hash and by header text and found no copy. My miss: I should have saved it. So a literal diff was not possible. (3) The mechanical checks below. A silent in-place edit that keeps a line count cannot be excluded, but every row I analysed in round 1 reads the same.

F1-F8

- F2 (LOW) RESOLVED. 9.2 (line 989): tree() returns one string, entries joined with "\n", extra optional. grep of tools/test: 8 call sites in 4 files (apply.reject.test.js:8,11; apply.accept.test.js:66,70; apply.state.test.js:14,16; cli.test.js:32,37), all assert.equal on strings. THE DESIGNER'S EXTRAS: all accepted. W38 mtime rule: correct (the foreign file's mtime is unknowable; the unchanged entries stay compared in full). "Half" = the first floor(n/2) characters of the string (9.2, effect table): correct and needed, the fixture text is Cyrillic; for the ASCII run.json the character half equals the byte half, so the pre-fix P13 result I measured in round 1 (517 of 1035 B) is unchanged. snapshot.js row (5.7): wording now true (see F5). Header: the outdated sentence is gone; it records my round-2 FAIL (06:42Z) and the round-3 note, and it matches what changed (see N3 for one cosmetic slip). Q3 probes (12): probe-r3 holds links.mjs, snap.mjs, umask.mjs; I re-ran the four claims it lists (validate through a link exit 0 and apply-verdict writing outside <root>; W13b; the 0o644 literal under umask 077; snapshot not listing an empty folder): all true.

RULING ON CRITERION 11 AND THE F6 CORNER. Consistent; no REQ-ANALYST edit is needed for this gate. The sentence: "...каждая цель — как до запуска или целиком новая, а если в STATE.md уже новое содержимое, то и в остальных целях тоже" (requirements.yaml unchanged). Read literally, it includes the state where STATE.md already equals the new text before the run and another target is old (STATE.md is then skipped, W1.5). That state exists before the run starts; a kill at the first instant leaves exactly it, so no implementation can satisfy the literal reading there. The only coherent reading of "уже" is the one the design states in 5.2, 5.3 (W3) and 9.1: when the run replaces STATE.md, it is replaced last, so every other replaced target is already new; the run never creates the mixed state. That is not a lowering of the bar: the reachable direction is tested (W47, W48; mutant M1), the unreachable one cannot be. Optional, ORCH's call (it would send REQ-002 back through REQ-VALIDATOR): tighten the clause to "а если запуск уже заменил STATE.md, то и остальные заменяемые цели уже новые", so that RELEASE-VALIDATOR has no room for the literal reading.

NEW FINDINGS (all LOW, non-blocking; the design is buildable and testable as it stands)

Also the ISS-0003 paragraph of 5.6 opens with "E_WRITE покрывает ... b и g1" and then says that part is not in this work; read it as "годится для".
